text: About 25% of ID-like fields include a leading # (e.g. #001Wt00000PFj4zIAD).
About 20% of text fields contain trailing whitespace (e.g. "Company Name ").
The corruption appears in the fields Id, AccountId, ContactId, Name, FirstName, LastName, Email, Subject and Status.
Handling the corruption is needed for reliable joins.
